content: Riegel's formula T2 = T1*(D2/D1)^1.06 is the general race-time-fatigue predictor (~80% accurate, optimistic beyond half-marathon). For threshold-pace specifically, coaching heuristics (Pfitzinger) are more directly usable: threshold pace ~= 5K pace + 6-9 sec/km (~1.03-1.05x, matching D-02's '5k pace x ~1.05' starting point); threshold pace ~= 10K pace + ~4-6 sec/km (~1.01-1.02x); threshold pace ~= half-marathon pace (~1.0x, sometimes slightly faster for recreational runners). These are coaching-derived offsets, not a single peer-reviewed formula.
